title: The Harvest of the Bell House
author: Ines Voss
blurb: Noor Coldharbour, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
